journal:
# Jana (p26) journal

## Day 1 (Sun 2026-10-04)
- Welcome screen fine. Profile form: Height and Age boxes sit side by side with the labels on one line above ("Height * cm | Age * years") — had to guess which box is which.
- Question "Have you already been eating at roughly your current intake for 2+ weeks?" — no idea honestly, picked "No / not sure".
- Profile never asked what my GOAL is. I want to lose 4 kg and after saving it just showed "maintain". Only found "Lose" by tapping the gear (⚙) on the Nutrition tab. There is no place to say "4 kg" — only a "% of body weight per week" (0.5 default). I don't think in % of body weight.
- Saving the profile created a "64 kg" weigh-in for today in Recent entries, even though I didn't weigh myself today (I just typed my usual weight).
- After Lose: maintenance 1,930 ± 450, target 1,630 kcal/day. ± 450 is huge?? Is it 1,500 or 2,400?
- Food log popup is okay. The first "Add entry" is a heading and the second is the button, slightly confusing.
- iPhone "Add to Home Screen" banner — ignored, tapped Got it.

## Day 2 (Mon)
- Weighed 64.1. Tapped "Weight" and got a trend chart instead of a place to type my weight — the big "Weight" tile and the "+ Weight" button have the same word. Needed "+ Weight".
- Weight form asks "Measured with BIA scale / DEXA / Calipers" — I just have a normal bathroom scale, don't know what BIA is. Left default.
- After saving: red-ish "▲ 0.1 kg" on day 2 — small, but feels like being told off already.
- Didn't log food today (busy).

## Day 3 (Tue)
- Opened the app, didn't log anything. Nothing to note.

## Day 4 (Wed)
- Didn't log again. Glanced at the Nutrition tab: still says 1,630 target.
- Nutrition tab on day 4 still said "An on-track check needs 14 days of data (day 1 so far)". It's day 4 and I weighed on day 2 — why "day 1"? (Maybe it only refreshes Sundays, but it reads like it's not counting.)

## Day 5 (Thu)
- Weighed 64.8 → "▲ 0.8 kg" at the top. Ugh, up almost a kilo in 4 days while "dieting". Discouraging. The "Trend weight 64.2" underneath is calmer but I only noticed it second.
- "Progress vs First vs Last" — not sure what those three words at the top mean; is ▲0.8 vs first entry?
- Didn't log food.

## Day 6 (Fri)
- No logging today.

## Day 7 (Sat)
- Logged all 4 meals again. Protein bar without macros works fine ("no macros").
- In "Last 14 days" my logged days say "4 entries | 1,729 kcal **open**". What does "open" mean? (Guess: I never ticked "Day complete".) Top still says "0 of the last 7 days are marked complete" — I logged 2 whole days, I didn't realise I had to tick a box as well. Felt a bit like the app ignored my logging.

## Week 1 (checked Sat 2026-10-10)
- Nutrition: maintenance 1,930 ± 450 kcal/day, target 1,630 (lose · 0.5%/wk). Label "Estimated", "0% from your data". Recommendation "Suggested intake: 1,630 kcal/day. An on-track check needs 14 days of data (day 1 so far)". No warnings.
- "Explain the math" = formulas (MAD, Hall 2008, Forbes, p × 1816…). Way over my head, closed it after 2 seconds. One thing I did catch: "3 daily weights used" — but I only weighed twice; the 64 I typed in my profile counts as a weigh-in.
- Body composition breakdown: "Not enough data yet", needs 3 readings at each end 21 days apart. OK, I don't have a body-fat scale anyway.
- What I understood: eat about 1,630 a day to lose. My week was roughly 1,550–1,900 so a bit over. Decision: try to eat ~1,630.

## Days 8–14 (routine, via my little script that taps through the app)
- NEW (day 9 morning): a banner on Nutrition "Mark yesterday (2026-10-11) complete? Yes, it's complete | Not complete | Review". Much easier than remembering the checkbox! I tap Yes sometimes, ignore it other times.
- Day 9 after the Sunday update: "kg/week (14-day) +0.50" and "95%: -1.62 to 2.61". So am I gaining half a kilo a week?? And the range goes from losing 1.6 to gaining 2.6 — that tells me nothing. Scary-then-meaningless.
- Day 12: scale said 62.4 → Body tab "▼ 1.6 kg". Finally!

## Week 2 (checked Sun 2026-10-18 morning)
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−1.09 kg to +0.20 kg per week) includes your target of −0.32 kg/week. Suggested intake: 1,700 kcal/day."
- Maintenance 2,000 ± 460 (Estimated, still "0% from your data"), target 1,700 (lose · 0.5%/wk). Avg intake 1,717, -0.45 kg/week.
- "Protein averaged 84 g on 1 logged day(s) vs 115 g" — I logged 4 days this week, why 1? (Small print further down says "1 complete day(s) with protein logged" — so it only counts ticked days with macros on every item.)
- Confused: "On track" but the range includes GAINING 0.2 kg/week. And my maintenance went UP from 1,930 to 2,000 while I'm losing — so I get to eat more? Nice, but I don't get why.
- Still "0% from your data" after 2 weeks and 2 complete days. Feels like my logging isn't counting.
- Decision: "On track" is all I really read. The target went up to 1,700, so I'll eat about 1,700.

## Days 15–21
- Nothing new popped up. The "Mark yesterday complete?" banner only shows when I logged yesterday, good. I logged 4 of 7 days, weighed twice (63.0, 62.4). Trend weight 63.2.

## Week 3 (checked Sun 2026-10-25 morning)
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.90 kg to +0.03 kg per week) includes your target of −0.32 kg/week. Suggested intake: 1,750 kcal/day."
- Maintenance 2,050 ± 430, target 1,750, Estimated, "9% from your data". Avg intake 1,648, -0.44 kg/week.
- Again the target went UP (1,630 → 1,700 → 1,750) while I'm losing. I'm happy about it but also: if I'm losing faster than the target, is that why? The app doesn't say "you're losing faster than planned, you may eat more" — it just says On track with a new number.
- Decision: eat ~1,750 like it says.

## Days 22–28
- Logged 5 of 7 days, weighed 62.5 then 60.5 (!!). Only 60.5 → 60 left to my goal of 60 kg (64 − 4).
- POSSIBLE BUG / UX: switching tabs keeps the old scroll position. If I scrolled down on Body (or after saving a weight the Body page jumps down to the tape measurements), tapping "Nutrition" opens it halfway down on the "Last 14 days" list — the "Mark yesterday complete?" banner and the Recommendation are off-screen above. So on several mornings I never saw the banner at all. Steps: Body tab → scroll bottom → tap Nutrition. Expected: Nutrition opens at the top. Actual: opens at the bottom of the list. Screenshot: tests/personas/run3/out/p26/screens/1790455240298.png

## Week 4 (checked Sun 2026-11-01 morning)
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−1.07 kg to −0.25 kg per week) includes your target of −0.31 kg/week. Suggested intake: 1,950 kcal/day."
- Maintenance 2,240 ± 380 (was 2,050), target 1,950 (was 1,750). Estimated, 30% from your data. Avg intake 1,761, -0.65 kg/week.
- Tapped "Yes, it's complete" for yesterday — and the rate range on screen changed a tiny bit right away (−1.07…−0.25 → −1.06…−0.24) although it says numbers only update on Sundays. Not a big deal, just odd.
- The app has no idea I'm basically at my goal weight. There's no "goal weight" anywhere, only "lose 0.5%/wk" forever. It keeps telling me to lose. I'll have to switch to Maintain myself when I hit 60.
- Decision: target jumped +200. I'll happily eat about 1,950.

## Days 29–35
- Bad week for logging: only day 34 logged (marked complete next morning via the banner). Weighed 62.1 and 61.9 — back UP from 60.5. Annoying, feels like the 60.5 was a fluke.

## Week 5 (checked Sun 2026-11-08 morning)
- NEW banner on both tabs: "It's been 30+ days since your last backup. Your data lives only on this device. Back up now | Later". Tapped Back up now → it opens a "Your data" page instead of just backing up; I had to find "Full backup (JSON)" myself. That worked: downloads/bodytracker-backup-2026-11-08.json, "Last backup: 2026-11-08". It also says "Persistent storage: not granted by the browser" — no idea what I'm supposed to do about that.
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.76 kg to −0.06 kg per week) includes your target of −0.31 kg/week. Suggested intake: 1,830 kcal/day."
- Maintenance 2,120 ± 320 (down from 2,240), target 1,830 (down from 1,950). Estimated, 49% from your data. Avg intake 2,034 (that's just the ONE complete day — the week I barely logged). -0.41 kg/week.
- Body tab: 61.9, ▼ 2.1 kg (vs first). Trend 62.1.
- My read: last week it told me to eat 1,950, then I went up in weight and now it's back down to 1,830. A bit whiplash-y. Still "On track" so I'm not panicking.
- Decision: eat ~1,830.

## Days 36–42
- Logged only days 41 and 42. Weighed 61.7 and 62.6. Stuck around 62 for two weeks.

## Week 6 (checked Sun 2026-11-15 morning)
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.44 kg to +0.17 kg per week) includes your target of −0.31 kg/week. Suggested intake: 1,720 kcal/day."
- Maintenance 2,010 ± 280, target 1,720. Label changed to **Measured** (63% from your data). Avg intake "—" (0 complete days in last 7 before I tapped yes), -0.14 kg/week.
- Confused: "On track" while the range includes gaining (+0.17) and my scale says I've gone from 60.5 back to 62.6. That doesn't feel on track to me. I'd rather it told me straight "you've stalled".
- "Measured" now — I guess that's good, means it trusts my data? Even though I barely logged these 2 weeks.
- Tapped "Yes, it's complete" for yesterday.
- Decision: eat ~1,720 like it says.

## Days 43–49
- Logged 5 of 7 days (the most so far), weighed 61.3 and 61.8. Body tab says ▼ 2.2 kg vs first. Trend 61.8–61.9. Nothing new popped up except the mark-yesterday banner.

## Week 7 (checked Sun 2026-11-22 morning)
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.49 kg to +0.06 kg per week) includes your target of −0.31 kg/week. Suggested intake: 1,730 kcal/day."
- Maintenance 2,020 ± 240 (range getting narrower, nice), target 1,730. Measured, 71% from your data. Avg intake 1,595 (2 complete days), -0.22 kg/week.
- My feeling: three weeks sitting at ~62 kg. The app keeps saying "On track", which is kind of the only thing keeping me going, but I'm not sure I believe it. My 14-day average "1,595" is lower than the 1,730 target — so why am I not losing more? Maybe my non-ticked days were bigger.
- Decision: keep ~1,730 as suggested.

## Days 50–56
- Logged 4 of 7 days. Weighed 60.9 and 61.2. Slowly moving again.

## Week 8 (checked Sun 2026-11-29 morning)
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.64 kg to −0.11 kg per week) includes your target of −0.31 kg/week. Suggested intake: 1,750 kcal/day."
- Maintenance 2,030 ± 220, target 1,750, Measured 76%. Avg intake 1,591 (1 complete day), -0.38 kg/week. "Protein averaged 68 g on 1 logged day(s) vs a 111 g target."
- Now the whole range is below zero, so I really am losing. That I understand. Protein: 111 g is a lot, I don't know how I'd eat that; the app doesn't tell me how, so I'll ignore it.
- Decision: keep ~1,750.

## Days 57–63
- Logged 3 of 7 days. Weighed 60.4 and 60.5. ▼ 3.5 kg on the Body tab!! Trend 60.9.

## Week 9 (checked Sun 2026-12-06 morning)
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.58 kg to −0.08 kg per week) includes your target of −0.30 kg/week. Suggested intake: 1,790 kcal/day."
- Maintenance 2,070 ± 210, target 1,790, Measured 79%. Avg intake 2,075 (1 complete day), -0.33 kg/week.
- Happy. Nearly at 60. Still nothing in the app knows my goal is 60, so I'll watch it myself.
- Decision: eat ~1,790.

## Days 64–70
- Logged 4 of 7 days. Weighed 61.3 and 61.1 — up again from 60.5. Honestly discouraging; I was so close.

## Week 10 (checked Sun 2026-12-13 morning)
- Backup reminder again ("30+ days since your last backup") — tapped Later, I'll do it at the end.
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.37 kg to +0.10 kg per week) includes your target of −0.31 kg/week. Suggested intake: 1,730 kcal/day."
- Maintenance 2,010 ± 200, target 1,730, Measured 81%. Avg intake 1,829 (2 complete days), -0.14 kg/week. Protein 74 g vs 110 g.
- "On track" again although I went back up. It says the same "On track" every single week no matter what — I've stopped trusting that word. It never once told me "you're off track" or "eat a bit less".
- Decision: 1,730 as suggested.

## Days 71–77
- Best logging week: 6 of 7 days logged. Weighed 61.2 and 60.1 — lowest yet!

## Week 11 (checked Sun 2026-12-20 morning)
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.34 kg to +0.12 kg per week) includes your target of −0.30 kg/week. Suggested intake: 1,740 kcal/day."
- Maintenance 2,020 ± 190, target 1,740, Measured 82%. Avg intake 1,936 (3 complete days), -0.11 kg/week. Protein 86 g vs 110 g.
- Scale says 60.1, basically my goal, but the app's "-0.11 kg/week" and trend 60.8 are less excited than me. Fine.
- Decision: keep ~1,740 for the last week, then probably switch to Maintain.

## Days 78–84
- Logged 4 of 7 days, weighed 60.2 and 60.6. Trend 60.6, ▼ 3.4 kg vs first.

## Week 12 (checked Sat 2026-12-26, last day)
- No new weekly update yet (next 2026-12-27), so same as week 11: maintenance 2,020 ± 190, target 1,740, Measured 82%, "On track". Avg intake tile now 1,658, -0.11 kg/week.

## End tasks
- "⇩" opens "Your data". Tapped Full backup (JSON) → downloads/bodytracker-backup-2026-12-26.json ("Last backup" updated). Daily data export → All data → Export daily data (JSON) → downloads/bodytracker-daily_2026-10-04_to_2026-12-24.json.
- Opened both. Daily export has one row per day with weight and food totals + "complete" true/false; 58 days, 44 food days, 21 complete, 25 weigh-in days — matches what the Your data page says. The 64 kg on 10-04 is the profile weight, not a real weigh-in. Days where some meals had no carbs/fat show just calories+protein, fine. Backup has everything (25 entries, 176 food entries, 21 days, settings, goals). It's a wall of JSON — I wouldn't open this on a phone, but it's there.
- Small text glitch on the export page: "58 day s with data · 25 weigh-in day s · 44 food day s" (the look text shows a gap in "day s"; the screenshot I checked on the math page rendered fine, so probably just how the text is split).

## Final review
Honestly it did help. I'm 3.4 kg down (64 → 60.6), almost exactly my goal, and I only logged about half my days. What I liked: the food log is quick, it doesn't punish me for skipping days ("unknown, not zero"), and the little "Mark yesterday complete?" banner is way easier than remembering a tick box. What confused me: the app never asked my goal weight — I had to dig into the gear to even pick "Lose", and it only talks in "% of body weight per week". The "± 450" and "95%: −1.62 to 2.61 kg/week" ranges mean nothing to me. It says "On track" every single week, even when my weight went back up for three weeks, so after a while I stopped believing it. The target moved every week (1,630 → 1,950 → 1,720…) and it never said why. Tabs opening halfway down meant I often missed the banner and the recommendation. And "Explain the math" is basically a physics exam. Would I keep using it? Maybe — for weighing and a rough calorie number yes, but I'd want it to know my goal weight and tell me plainly when I'm off track.
agentReply:
# p26 (Jana) final report

1. **Usage:** I opened the app on all 84 days (2026-10-04 to 12-26). I logged food on 44 days, 176 entries in total (about 4 meals a day). 21 days ended up marked complete, almost all of them through the "Mark yesterday complete?" banner. I weighed in 24 times; the app counts 25 weigh-ins because the weight I typed into my profile on day 1 was saved as a weigh-in. Weight went from 64 to 60.6 kg (trend 60.6).

2. **Weekly table**

| wk | maintenance shown | target | label | recommendation (short) | what I did |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 (10-10) | 1,930 ± 450 | 1,630 | Estimated 0% | Suggested 1,630; on-track check needs 14 days | plan 1,630 |
| 2 (10-18) | 2,000 ± 460 | 1,700 | Estimated 0% | On track (−1.09…+0.20 kg/wk), 1,700 | plan 1,700 |
| 3 (10-25) | 2,050 ± 430 | 1,750 | Estimated 9% | On track, 1,750 | plan 1,750 |
| 4 (11-01) | 2,240 ± 380 | 1,950 | Estimated 30% | On track, 1,950 | plan 1,950 |
| 5 (11-08) | 2,120 ± 320 | 1,830 | Estimated 49% | On track, 1,830 + 30-day backup reminder | made a backup, plan 1,830 |
| 6 (11-15) | 2,010 ± 280 | 1,720 | Measured 63% | On track (−0.44…+0.17), 1,720 | plan 1,720 |
| 7 (11-22) | 2,020 ± 240 | 1,730 | Measured 71% | On track, 1,730 | plan 1,730 |
| 8 (11-29) | 2,030 ± 220 | 1,750 | Measured 76% | On track, 1,750; protein 68 vs 111 g | plan 1,750 |
| 9 (12-06) | 2,070 ± 210 | 1,790 | Measured 79% | On track, 1,790 | plan 1,790 |
| 10 (12-13) | 2,010 ± 200 | 1,730 | Measured 81% | On track (−0.37…+0.10), 1,730 + backup reminder | tapped Later, plan 1,730 |
| 11 (12-20) | 2,020 ± 190 | 1,740 | Measured 82% | On track, 1,740 | plan 1,740 |
| 12 (12-26) | 2,020 ± 190 (no new update, next is 12-27) | 1,740 | Measured 82% | same as week 11 | backup + daily export |

3. **Confusions**
- **Profile form:** the Height and Age boxes sit side by side under one label line, so I had to guess which box was which.
- **Profile, goal:** the form never asked my goal. After saving it showed "maintain". I only found Lose/Maintain/Gain behind the ⚙ on the Nutrition tab. There is nowhere to enter a goal weight, only "% of body weight per week".
- **"2+ weeks at current intake" question:** I didn't know what to answer.
- **Body tab:** tapping the "Weight" tile opens a trend chart. To enter a weight I had to use "+ Weight", which uses the same word.
- **Weight form:** "Measured with BIA / DEXA / Calipers" meant nothing to me with a normal bathroom scale.
- **Nutrition:** "± 450" and "95%: −1.62 to 2.61 kg/week" are ranges so wide they told me nothing.
- **Nutrition, day 4:** it said "needs 14 days of data (day 1 so far)" on day 4.
- **Nutrition, first week:** my logged days showed as "open", and the tab said "0 of 7 days complete". I didn't know I also had to tick "Day complete".
- **Protein:** it said "averaged X g on 1 logged day(s)" in weeks when I had logged 4–5 days. It only counts days marked complete where every meal had macros.
- **Recommendation:** it said "On track" every week, even when the range included gaining and while my weight went back up for three weeks. The target moved every week (1,630 → 1,950 → 1,720) and it never said why.
- **Explain the math:** full of formulas (MAD, Hall 2008, Forbes). I closed it right away.
- **Your data:** "Back up now" opens a data page instead of backing up. "Persistent storage: not granted by the browser" — I didn't know what to do about it.

4. **Possible bugs**
- **Tabs keep their scroll position.** Steps: Body tab → scroll to the bottom (saving a weight also leaves Body scrolled down at the tape measurements) → tap Nutrition. Expected: Nutrition opens at the top. Actual: it opens at the bottom of the "Last 14 days" list, so the "Mark yesterday complete?" banner and the Recommendation are hidden above. I missed the banner on some mornings. Screenshot: tests/personas/run3/out/p26/screens/1790455240298.png
- **The profile weight is saved as a real weigh-in.** Steps: set up the profile with 64 kg on a day I didn't weigh. Expected: it's only used for the starting estimate. Actual: a 64 kg weigh-in appears in Recent entries, "Explain the math" counts it ("3 daily weights used" when I had weighed twice), and it is in both exports.
- **Minor:** after tapping "Yes, it's complete" for yesterday, the recommendation's rate range changed right away (−1.07…−0.25 → −1.06…−0.24), even though the screen says it updates weekly. Screenshot: tests/personas/run3/out/p26/screens/1790455248913.png
- **Checked and fine:** the backup and daily export files (tests/personas/run3/out/p26/downloads/) open correctly. Their counts match the app: 58 days with data, 44 food days, 21 complete, 25 weigh-in days.

5. **Review (Jana):** "I lost 3.4 kg while only logging about half my days, so it kind of worked. Logging is quick and the 'mark yesterday complete?' banner saved me. But it never knew my goal weight, and it said 'On track' every single week even when I was going back up, so I stopped trusting it. The ± ranges and the math page went right over my head." Would keep using: **maybe**.

Files: journal at tests/personas/run3/out/p26/journal.md, routine script at tests/personas/run3/out/p26/daily.mjs, per-day logs in tests/personas/run3/out/p26/logs/.
